charger_path.module_carried_contact_block: Preferred: contact block is carried by the REAR/battery carrier module with a face-seal against the caseback aperture, so the harness stays attached to J202 when the case is opened (a flying harness would have to be unplugged from a connector that sits under the display).
charger_path.keying_and_alignment: mechanical key/recess and retention only; no magnet (frozen invariant). Cable-side pogo geometry SUPPLIER_DATA_REQUIRED (CHG-MECH).
charger_path.magnetometer_note: Order-of-magnitude physics, not a measurement: a single conductor carrying 0.4 A (charge-current setting, charger_harness.md) at d = 10 mm gives mu0*I/(2*pi*d) = 8 uT, comparable to the geomagnetic field; a tightly coupled +5V/GND pair reduces the far field by about the conductor-separation/distance ratio. Therefore route as a pair and characterise on a prototype.

J1501 and J201 mouths (reservation r up to 22.66 / 22.80) sit in the 21.95-23.0 band beyond the display outline, but can only be mated before the display is seated. J202 (r <= 20.76) is wholly under the display. Therefore every F.Cu mating and the SWD session must happen in build state S1 (MAIN + battery + REAR module, display absent).

conflicts.title: FPC edge-wrap versus case inner radius
conflicts.description: The tool 180-degree wrap model fails at the nominal corner (margin -0.47). A 2 x 90-degree out-and-down routing (J1501 mouth facing outward, bend starting at the display outline) passes nominal by 0.58 mm but fails the conservative corner by 1.05 mm; the plain straight run beside the pack already fails conservative by 0.95 mm, so the conservative failure is a case-wall / channel budget issue, not a bend-type issue.
evidence: zstack.md radial table: margin_edge_wrap -0.47 / -2.10 / 0.70, margin_straight_run 0.68 / -0.95 / 1.40 (nominal / conservative / optimistic)
Out-and-down arithmetic: R_inner = max(R_display 21.95 + R_bend_min, R_channel_inner, R_main); R_outer = R_inner + t_fpc + c_fpc; margin = R_case_inner - R_outer -> 0.58 / -1.05 / 1.30
margin_main_to_case (tool): 1.05 / 0.40 / 1.50 mm is the whole annulus available for every crossing

Recovery needed at the conservative corner: 1.05 mm (out-and-down). Candidate levers by parameter range: local case wall 1.6 -> 1.0 (+0.6), c_radial 1.0 -> 0.5 (+0.5), t_carrier_wall 0.6 -> 0.3 (+0.3, straight run), R_bend_min 2.0 -> 1.2 (+0.8, out-and-down)

steps.action: MAIN bring-up: first-boot SWD at J1301 and rail check at TP13xx (display absent, battery absent).
Mount battery in carrier (B.Cu pockets for C901..C906, R901..R910, C206; insulation film); mate J201 from the south-west edge.
REAR module sub-assembly: REAR board + barrier + window/pod insert tested on its own; FPC attached at J1502 / tail.
Mate J1501 (mouth outward) and the charger strip to J202; fold FPC out-and-down into the carrier channel; seat REAR in the lower web.
Module functional test: SWD, PPG, MAX30208, charge entry via test dock - all F.Cu items still reachable.
Install MAIN on the case supports (SW/SE/NE and a W/NW support) and seat the display (V1: module into the display-bonded case, J1 Z-push; V2: hinge closed after J1 mating). Counts one J1 cycle.
Caseback with gasket and screws; hard stops carry load; contact block face-seal; vent membrane and button seals checked.

assembly.rework_rule: Any rework requiring F.Cu access returns the unit to S1 (display removed). Planned J1 seatings <= 25 of the rated 50.
